nodes.label: Sukrit Saha Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Main portfolio application showcasing developer projects and skills

nodes.label: Awwwards minimal design
nodes.rationale: Design philosophy: minimal aesthetic with emphasis on typography and interaction

nodes.label: Custom cursor system
nodes.rationale: Two-part cursor: solid dot (1:1 tracking) + trailing ring (lerped 0.18/frame)

nodes.label: Inertia scrolling
nodes.rationale: Wheel hijack + lerp loop (0.14/frame) for smooth trailing scroll feel

nodes.label: Scroll-triggered reveals
nodes.rationale: IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.15) for staggered fade+slide animations

nodes.label: Magnetic links
nodes.rationale: Elements translate 35% toward cursor on hover, reset on leave

nodes.label: Dynamic hero word
nodes.rationale: Auto-cycles tagline words every 2.6s with fade/slide transitions, pausable on hover

nodes.label: React 18 SPA
nodes.rationale: Single-page app: no routing, no state library, vanilla JS hooks for interaction

nodes.label: Vite 5 build system
nodes.rationale: Modern bundler for fast dev/build cycles

nodes.label: OKLCH design tokens
nodes.rationale: Palette: bg (warm off-white), text, muted, line, wash, accent (moss green)

nodes.label: Typography system
nodes.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque (display), Instrument Sans (body), all fluid via clamp()

nodes.label: Preloader component
nodes.rationale: Full-screen overlay: 650ms delay then slide-up over 800ms cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)

nodes.label: Navigation component
nodes.rationale: Fixed header with wordmark (left) + Work/About/Contact links (right), blurred backdrop

nodes.label: Hero section
nodes.rationale: Full viewport: eyebrow, 3-line headline with dynamic word, subtext, scroll cue

nodes.label: Work section
nodes.rationale: 9 project rows with accordion expand, floating preview swatch, cursor hover

nodes.label: ProjectRow component
nodes.rationale: Expandable row: index + title + details (meta, blurb, tags, code link)

nodes.label: About section
nodes.rationale: Statement paragraph + 3-column toolkit grid (Interface, Backend, AI Layer)

nodes.label: Contact section
nodes.rationale: Giant mailto link + secondary links (Resume, GitHub, LinkedIn, X)

nodes.label: Footer component
nodes.rationale: Copyright + back-to-top link, hairline top border

nodes.label: Grain overlay
nodes.rationale: Fixed 40% opacity noise tile, drifting horizontally 55s loop

nodes.label: Projects data
nodes.rationale: 9 projects: titles, meta, blurbs, tags, media (image/video), code/link URLs

nodes.label: Agent-Native Workflows
nodes.rationale: Prototyping full-stack products with Claude Code + agent orchestration, ongoing

nodes.label: Claspr
nodes.rationale: Classroom platform: Next.js, TypeScript, tRPC, PostgreSQL, solo end-to-end

nodes.label: Limetta
nodes.rationale: Expense tracker: multi-account, transfers, dues, replaces 3 finance apps

nodes.label: YNAB-Style Expense
nodes.rationale: Personal finance dashboard built end-to-end with Claude Code

nodes.label: Spitha Diamonds
nodes.rationale: Freelance e-commerce storefront for jewelry brand

nodes.label: Otaku-Sphere
nodes.rationale: Open-source anime community: watchlists, leaderboards, polls

nodes.label: Polymer Bazaar
nodes.rationale: B2B dashboard for polymer trade market data, client work

nodes.label: Typournament
nodes.rationale: Competitive typing tournaments: brackets, live WPM, leaderboards

nodes.label: useIsTouch hook
nodes.rationale: Memoized matchMedia check (pointer: coarse) disables all cursor/scroll gimmicks on touch

nodes.label: Interaction design philosophy
nodes.rationale: Motion via inline styles + CSS transitions, no animation library. Hand-rolled vanilla JS hooks driving requestAnimationFrame

nodes.label: Stack philosophy
nodes.rationale: Minimal tooling: no CSS framework, no animation library, no router, no state library. Plain CSS + vanilla JS

nodes.label: Sukrit Saha
nodes.rationale: Frontend engineer from Bengaluru, India. Currently at Sumeru Inc. Builds with Claude Code + agentic tooling
